verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say receipts are captured and memos and categories filled in at swipe time, transactions are coded to the correct GL account and auto-approved within policy, and accounting fields sync to QuickBooks in real time with a built-in reconciliation tool. Missing items trigger automated reminders, and the CLI and MCP can surface missing receipts and memos and suggest memos, so close becomes a review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy, explicit evidence of merchant-level coding or normalization.
